name: @openloomi/benchmark-gdpval-aa-v2
description: OpenLoomi-native runner for the GDPval-AA v2 evaluation (openai/gdpval gold subset, 220 tasks, 44 occupations). Streams tasks through the local OpenLoomi /api/native/agent harness, collects real file deliverables per task, and emits pairwise-grader-ready submission JSONL.
